# Jack Kelm, CMSE

> Automation engineer, mechanical engineer, and Certified Machinery Safety Expert (CMSE) based in Northfield, Ohio (Cleveland–Akron area).

## Summary

Jack Kelm is an automation engineer with 9 years of experience at Parker Hannifin (Macedonia, OH). He specializes in industrial robot cell design, manufacturing automation consulting, computer vision, additive manufacturing, and robot / machinery safety (RIA R15.06 / R15.08). He has identified $55M+ in yearly savings across Parker North American plants and provided technical expertise on 800+ robot cell projects.

He is a CMSE® — Certified Machinery Safety Expert (Pilz training; examined and certified by TÜV NORD CERT). Certificate No. 44 506 26 094038 0447. Valid March 13, 2026 – March 13, 2030.
